section.title: Safety information on patient transport and positioning
section.hierarchy_path: /Safety information/Safety information on patient transport and positioning

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 2.3 Safety information on patient transport and positioning
For safe and secure patient transport and patient positioning, observe the following sections depending on your workflow.
WARNING
Incorrect patient positioning, unintended patient movement, and unobserved movement of the patient table or gantry!
Injury to the patient, for example, contusions of the patient's extremities and unusable radiation.
◆ Always fix the patient with accessories, as described in the instructions for use, to avoid unintentional patient movement. For example, use restraint straps and arm supports.

◆ Monitor the patient continuously as long as the table top and gantry are moving. Take special care if the tilt of the gantry is anything other than zero degrees or the table height is anything other than the isocenter.

◆ Make sure that nothing can get caught while the table or gantry are moving. For example, parts of the body or clothing, any needles, infusion tubes, respiration tubes, catheters, ECG cables, or sheets and blankets.
◆ Follow the markings and labels on the equipment.
◆ Press a STOP key if an injury to the patient can occur.
WARNING
Incorrect patient positioning!
Injury to the patient or personnel, and damage to the equipment.
◆ Always verify that the patient is correctly positioned.
◆ Always observe the patient during system movements.
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
2 Safety information
WARNING
Incorrect patient positioning!
Injury to the patient by moving parts.
◆ Make sure that neither the patient's clothing nor hair can get caught in mechanical parts.

◆ Make sure that infusion lines and respiration tubes, catheters and ECG cables cannot get caught in the space between the table top and the side parts. These components must not be put under tensile stress in any other way.
◆ Make sure that patient bedding cannot get caught by moving parts of the patient table.
◆ Use positioning aids as described.
The patient table and accessories are designed for certain maximum loads.
WARNING
Exceeding the maximum load of the equipment, for example, patient table, overlays, accessories, and the assembly of accessories!
Injury to the patient or the personnel, or damage to the equipment.
◆ Make sure that the permissible maximum load of the equipment is not exceeded. The permissible maximum load of the equipment is displayed on the applied labels.
◆ Verify that the permissible maximum load is not exceeded for:
Each single item of equipment applied or plugged into the patient table. For example, positioning aids and overlays.
Equipment to which other equipment is attached. For example, accessory rail or infusion bottle holder.
The patient must always be positioned on the patient table.
Never position the patient directly in the gantry!

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 3.5.4 Control box
The control box can be used to control measurements and the patient table.
You can switch on or off the system.
You can start or stop a measurement.
You can move the patient table from outside of the examination room.
You can communicate with the patient from outside of the examination room.

It is within the responsibility of the personnel to make sure that no conflictive table movements or software actions are performed when the control box, the gantry operator panels, or the panel of the i-Control are in use.
A radiation warning lamp lights up and a warning signal sounds when X-radiation is being generated.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02

section.title: Neuro BestContrast
section.hierarchy_path: /Dose management and optimization/Dose optimization features/Neuro BestContrast

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 5.1.8 Neuro BestContrast
Neuro BestContrast improves image quality during the image reconstruction phase of head examinations. It improves contrast enhancement with a minimal increase in image noise.
Neuro BestContrast is applied to all head kernels with a kernel sharpness value of < 45 and with iBHC turned on (for example, bone or iodine).
The image is divided into two data sets:
Low spatial frequencies
The low frequency pass image is reconstructed and tissue contrast is improved. During this reconstruction phase, the increase in noise is minimal.
High spatial frequencies
The high frequency pass image data contains the sharp details and original noise. During this reconstruction phase, noise is curbed.
Finally, both data sets are merged, resulting in an improved image that has a better contrast-to-noise ratio.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 196

section.hierarchy_path: /Quality assurance/Constancy test of the monitor/Performing the biannual metrological tests

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 9.6.5 Performing the biannual metrological tests
It is highly recommended that the biannual tests are performed by Siemens Healthineers Service.
If you prefer to perform the tests by yourself, make sure that the tests and the documentation of the test results are compliant to DIN 6868-157: 2014.
1 In the Patient Browser, select the test images stored in the database under Local Database/Image Quality Test/TG 18/TG 18 Testimages Monochrome.
2 Load the test images into the Viewing task card.
3 On the View subtask card, select the 1:1 layout.
4 Perform the following tests.
Minimum luminance
Maximum luminance
Veiling glare
Illuminance
Homogeneity of multiple monitors
Luminance response
5 Document your test results and confirm them with date and initials.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
9 Quality assurance
The test result shows deviations up to 20%.
◆ You can contact Siemens Healthineers Service to set information.
The test result shows deviations of 30% or more.
◆ You must contact Siemens Healthineers Service that the monitor must be newly adjusted.
